effect_description_eng:
＜Scapegoat＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted other than by your effects, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, prevent that deletion.)
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have 1 or more memory, you may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [DS], [Mollusk] or [Crustacean] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [DS], [Mollusk] or [Crustacean] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
